pages.title: Pocket Kitten
pages.text: Use the bell on one of your tamed cats to let it ride on you. Your furry companion will travel with you from your shoulder.

Using the bell with an empty hand summons a new tamed cat that already belongs to you, then places it on your shoulder. The bell has 16 uses. A shoulder cat is safely carried along on your adventures—and is always ready to make your travels cuter.
